commands.name: RecordRmaInboundReceipt
steps: outside lock normalize physical keys and preview promised-vs-actual mismatch
inside UoW require RMA has no direct inbound unit and current request/RMA identity valid

insert receipt command_receipt; create immutable Spare Part Unit origin=direct_rma_receipt with actual facts; create rma_direct_inbound_units relationship; append actual receipt logistics event plus RMA/unit participants; append unit received event
rebuild unit/Stock/RMA attention projections and audit/commit
rules: actual BOM/serial may differ from promised and are never overwritten into RMA
receipt creates actual physical unit; before receipt no provisional physical unit exists

commands.name: RecordActualLogisticsEvent
input: nonempty exact RMA/Spare Part/Device Part participants
steps: validate bounded historical snapshots outside lock
inside UoW revalidate every participant identity and event-specific prerequisite
insert receipt/logistics event and one participant row per target
append unit lifecycle/custody facts only where the event semantically owns them
rebuild affected unit/RMA attention projections and audit/commit
rules: one event may cover many participants but each participant is independently addressable
local unit does not receive fabricated external logistics

commands.name: AcceptInventoryPhysicalConsequence
steps: outside lock read exact reviewed Task outcome through TaskOperationalEvidenceReader and preview supported physical consequence
inside UoW re-read Task review fingerprint and relevant Task allocations/RMA assignment/inbound/target relationships
reject stale/contradictory physical facts
insert receipt; create consequence identity and accept event
rebuild physical consequence projection; append appropriate unit/device-part lifecycle relationships/events without editing Task state
run RETURN_SELECTION_V1 when RMA applies and establish exact open return obligation from accepted disposition
rebuild Stock/RMA/Fault Tag eligibility/attention and audit/commit
rules: Task review is prerequisite but does not itself create Inventory consequence
successful replacement normally returns removed Device Part Unit; unused/faulty/incompatible returns inbound unit; dismantled returns parent assembly
local replacement without RMA is valid

commands.name: CorrectInventoryPhysicalConsequence
steps: outside lock read current upstream Task review; if Task review changed require reviewed re-evaluation rather than copying old result
inside UoW target exact current-effective consequence event and validate replacement relationships
insert receipt/correct or supersede event
append targeted corrections to dependent installed/removed/return-selection relationships; never delete original events
rebuild all affected projections and invalidate incompatible Fault Tag draft eligibility; submitted history requires separate replacement workflow
audit/commit
commands.rule: Inventory correction never rewrites Task outcome history

commands.name: CorrectLogisticsParticipant
steps: inside UoW prove exact participant relation is disputed without invalidating unrelated participants
insert receipt and close/correct only that relationship; append replacement participant when required
rebuild affected target projections/audit/commit
commands.rule: correcting one participant never rewrites shared logistics event or other participants
